events.verdict: Tucker (HOU) makes contact with Johnson's (MIA) left wrist after the release of his jump shot attempt and affects his ability to follow through naturally.
Nene (HOU) is in the lane for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Richardson (MIA) moves into and makes contact with Harden's (HOU) body during the follow-through of his jump shot attempt, affecting his ability to follow through naturally.
Nene (HOU) engages with Whiteside (MIA) as he sets the screen and disengages without affecting his FOM.
Green (HOU) is in the lane for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Gordon (HOU) is drawn into the air on the pump fake and makes contact with Wade (MIA) during his upward shooting motion.
Tucker (HOU) makes a natural move toward the lane after initial contact takes place with Richardson (MIA) during the pick.
Jones Jr. (MIA) makes "high-five" contact with Harden's (HOU) hand after the release of his jump shot attempt.
Harden (HOU) steps into Richardson's (MIA) landing area on his jump shot attempt, but the contact is marginal.
Jones Jr. (MIA) makes marginal contact with Gordon's (HOU) front that does not affect his ability to maintain control of the ball.
Harden (HOU) places, but does not extend, his left forearm against Jones Jr.'s (MIA) front as marginal contact is made at the end of the drive.
Gordon (HOU) makes marginal contact with Richardson (MIA) along the perimeter that does not affect his FOM.
Nene (HOU) makes "high-five" contact with Wade (MIA) after the release of his jump shot attempt.
Nene (HOU) makes marginal contact with Wade (MIA) during the drive.
[Observable in enhanced video] Wade (MIA) slides his pivot foot prior to the start of his upward shooting motion.
Harden (HOU) places and slightly extends his hand against Whiteside's (MIA) backside during rebounding, but does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Wade (MIA) makes incidental contact with Tucker (HOU) during the rebound.
LAR shows Tucker (HOU) moves out of his screening position and delivers contact to Jones Jr. (MIA) that affects his ability to defend.
Wade (MIA) makes "high-five" contact with Gordon (HOU) after the release of his jump shot attempt.
